character.name: Marrow Voss
traits: Polite, unassuming demeanor that disarms all suspicion
Follows a rigid kill ritual, believes the 13th victim will grant a dark boon
Collects small, undetectable trophies from every victim
Expert at hiding in plain sight as the village's helpful neighbor
character.gear: Serrated bone dagger · Tanned leather jerkin · Butcher's cleaver · Vial of nightshade poison · Bundle of dried offering herbs · 50 ft hemp rope · Tarnished silver holy symbol
character.story: Apprenticed to the village butcher at 12, Marrow learned to cut flesh cleanly, hide stains, move without sound. When the thin harvest moon rose, he felt a pull to the old crossroads, left his first offering: a stray no one would miss. Now the village’s quietest neighbor—polishing the guard’s armor, carrying elders’ groceries—he counts his victims. The thirteenth will complete the pattern, he swears, and the dark thing in the crossroads will finally answer.

inventory.name: Serrated Bone Dagger
inventory.lore: Forged from a reaper's broken scythe blade, sharpened on the butcher's stone where he learned to dress carcasses. The serrations leave wounds that never fully close, a signature of his early kills.
inventory.description: A small, wickedly serrated dagger balanced for quick, precise thrusts.

inventory.name: Tanned Leather Jerkin
inventory.lore: Cured from the hide of a stray dog he found dying in the butcher's alley, stitched with thread dyed in the blood of his first victim. It fits him like a second skin, silent when he moves.
inventory.description: Soft, well-worn leather armor that offers silent protection.

inventory.name: Butcher's Cleaver
inventory.lore: The cleaver he was apprenticed with, still stained with old blood. He keeps it hidden in his floorboards, uses it to prepare his ritual offering meat before each kill.
inventory.description: A heavy, well-balanced cleaver perfect for splitting bone and meat alike.

inventory.name: Vial of Nightshade Poison
inventory.lore: Distilled from belladonna grown in the abandoned graveyard behind his cottage, the poison causes a painless, sleep-like death that leaves no mark on the skin.
inventory.description: A small glass vial of thick, dark purple poison that smells faintly of overripe berries.
inventory.effects: On a successful hit, target must make DC 13 CON save or take 1d4 poison damage and be poisoned for 1 hour. A failed save by 5 or more causes the target to fall unconscious for the duration.

inventory.name: Bundle of Dried Offering Herbs
inventory.lore: A mix of sage, mugwort, and yarrow collected from the churchyard, burned as an offering to the dark spirit he believes guides his kills.
inventory.description: A small bundle of dried, fragrant herbs tied with twine.

inventory.name: 50 ft Hemp Rope
inventory.lore: Used to bind his victims during the ritual, the rope is knotted with small, hidden sigils carved into each fiber.
inventory.description: A coarse, sturdy rope frayed slightly at the ends.

inventory.name: Tarnished Silver Holy Symbol
inventory.lore: Stolen from the local chapel's donation box, he wears it around his neck to appear devout, masking his true nature from the townsfolk.
inventory.description: A dented silver pendant depicting a forgotten harvest god, dulled by years of neglect.
inventory.effects: Grants advantage on Deception checks when pretending to be a pious civilian.
